item.title: Path is uneven all the way to Chemist, 24th September
item.description:
From alleyway by the school to the end of the road by the chemist. The path is very uneven and narrow. My Friend is 89, has very difficult mobility and finds it very difficult and dangerous to walk this path with her roller/rollator. She is unable to walk along the road because of her difficulty in walking and the vehicles parked on both sides of the road and it is busy at the junction with Dinglewell. I am very concerned about the risk of her tripping and falling. This has been like this for at least 10years.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Brookfield Road, Hucclecote, Gloucester
